entries.title: Remove Supabase, complete local database functionality
entries.summary: Replaced Supabase with a fully-functional local SQLite database. No Supabase configuration, client, or dependency remains anywhere in the codebase. Implemented auto JSON serialization/deserialization for SQLite, unique task_id constraint for context_messages, and an in-process pub/sub mechanism to replace Supabase realtime features.

entries.title: Account roles + retire ai_providers planning
entries.summary: Added role ('orchestrator', 'worker', 'qa') and label fields to Jules accounts, enforcing role during acquisition. Overhauled config loader to read accounts directly from the SQLite database with a one-time migration fallback. Exposed account roles/labels in list, create, and patch backend endpoints and the React Dashboard UI.

entries.title: Consolidate plan execution onto WorkflowEngine and retire System B
entries.summary: Consolidated plan execution entirely onto System A's robust, parallel WorkflowEngine and AgentCoordinator, retiring legacy standalone execution and buggy polling loops. Integrated GitHub-based branch creation and JDOCS-compliant prompt generation directly into task workflows. Enforced strict role-aware and assign-to constraints on accounts pool with hard-fail routing.

entries.title: Implement dependency-scoped cancellation and orchestrator notify/relay mechanisms
entries.summary: Implemented dependency-scoped transitive closure cancellation in WorkflowEngine. Created single state-transition notifications (COMPLETED, FAILED, AWAITING_USER_FEEDBACK, PAUSED) and worker-to-orchestrator feedback relay loops with lock-based turn serialization per orchestrator session. Fixed session activity tracking to store full Activity JSON payloads.

entries.title: Add mandatory pre-merge QA review gate using dedicated qa account
entries.summary: Added a mandatory, pre-merge, report-only QA review gate using a dedicated qa-role Jules account with prompt template interpolation and JSON verdict block extraction. Fixed the CI checks wait block in AutoMerge to prevent merging on CI failures or timeouts, and integrated internal QA verdict lookup inside merge_when_ready to ensure no merge-check bypass. Rejected verdicts notify the responsible orchestrator of the specific blocking issues.

entries.title: Establish integration_branch and Integrator review logic for multi-task workflows
entries.summary: Introduced dynamic integration branch creation for multi-task workflows. Added AccountRole.INTEGRATOR. Refactored per-task branching to derive off the integration branch. Implemented a post-QA, pre-final-PR Integrator review session to catch cross-agent integration issues, with approval/rejection logic managing final PR merges and branch cleanup.

entries.title: Establish human plan approval gate and visible decision history APIs
entries.summary: Added an explicit human plan approval gate to standing orchestrator sessions. Implemented first-class orchestrator_sessions tracking table and management endpoints. Enhanced polling loops in coordinator.py and session_runner.py to handle AWAITING_PLAN_APPROVAL. Exposed decision history APIs and surfaced pending approvals on the dashboard.

entries.title: Support nested orchestrator delegation with configurable recursion limits
entries.summary: Allowed tasks in a workflow with assign_to pointing to an orchestrator account to resolve to an ORCHESTRATOR role session, creating a sub-orchestrator. Programmed automatic parent task ID tracking and prompt reframing to convey delegating responsibility. Built configuration limits guarding against runaway recursion depth.

entries.title: Establish graceful account pool exhaustion backoff and delayed dispatch
entries.summary: Prevented pool exhaustion from triggering task failures. Implemented proactive capacity checking in WorkflowEngine, holding ready tasks until capacity frees up. Added a bounded retry and backoff loop for AccountPoolExhausted in coordinator.py, and routed waiting_on_capacity status notifications to the orchestrator.

entries.title: Assert SQLite WAL mode concurrency stability
entries.summary: Assured that SQLite connections utilize WAL mode and busy timeouts of 5000ms. Implemented a highly-stressed, multi-session parallel write test to assert zero database lock-contention exceptions occur under realistic concurrent workloads.
